Requirement: Members book classes without calling or visiting the front desk.

Rationale: Mobile app moved to a later release.

Requirement: Members can book a class online and cancel it up to 1 hour before it starts.
When a class is full, members can join a waitlist.
Members receive a reminder 24 hours before the class.
Trainers see the list of booked members for their class.
Cancellations later than 1 hour before the class count as a no-show and block booking for 7 days.
A member on the waitlist must accept a freed place within 30 minutes.
Members can see their booking history for the last 3 months.
The booking service is available 99.5% of the time during club opening hours.
